summary.name: Relevance AI Invent 2.0
summary.one_liner: Invent 2.0 is Relevance AI's platform for identifying business workflows to automate and building, deploying, and improving teams of AI agents.
use_cases: build a team of sales agents
automate post-call follow-ups and CRM updates
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes Invent 2.0 as a service and platform for mapping workflows to find agent use cases, then building customized agents with evaluation, monitoring, and governance. It mentions an embedded deployment team that gets a company live and trains staff to build agents themselves. Example sales agents listed include a pre-meeting prepper, a post-call actioner, a meeting scheduler, an outbound prospector, and a forecast roll-up. Enterprise features named are data residency, PII masking, audit logs, role-based access control, SSO/SAML, human-in-the-loop approvals, version control, real-time monitoring, full agent tracing, cost visibility, and OTEL and Delta Share export. The page says it connects to 1,000+ apps.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">unknown
notable: Embedded deployment team that trains your staff to build agents independently
Enterprise governance: audit logs, PII masking, data residency, SSO/SAML, human-in-the-loop approvals
Targets autonomous Level 3 and Level 4 agent workforces
caveats: Positioned for enterprise teams; pricing is not stated on the page
Deployment involves an embedded team and onboarding rather than self-serve setup only
Marketing-heavy page; claimed results come from named customer case studies
